meta.title: Rondje · a regular walk with a dog who's waiting for you
meta.description: Rondje connects young adults with dogs from neighbours and shelters that could really use an extra walk. Free and safe, in the Netherlands, Belgium and Spain.

footer.tagline: Rondje is a free platform that puts walkers, owners and shelters in touch. Rondje itself is not a party to any arrangements made.
footer.demo: Demo mode: no database is connected yet. Data is not saved.

home.title: A regular walk with a dog <mark>who's waiting for you.</mark>
home.lede: Rondje connects young adults with the dogs of neighbours who can't walk far any more, and with shelter dogs. Free, safe and good for you both.
home.how1: Create a profile with a photo and say a bit about yourself.
home.how2: Choose a dog and request a first meeting. The owner or the shelter is always there.
home.how3: Hit it off? Then you can walk the dog on your own. The owner can see where you are, live.
home.how4: Go for a regular walk every week. Afterwards, tell us privately how it went.
home.forWalkersText: Time outdoors, a regular plan and a dog who's happy to see you. Aged 18 and over, free of charge.
home.forOwnersText: Can't walk far any more? You decide who walks your dog, for how long, and whether treats are allowed. Family can sign you up too.
home.forSheltersText: Put all your dogs online in one go, plan supervised group walks and get a regular group of young volunteers.
home.safetyTitle: Trust is built step by step
home.safety1: The first time, you always walk together with the owner or the shelter.
home.safety2: ID is checked in person at the first meeting. Rondje doesn't keep a copy.
home.safety3: Solo walks are only possible once the owner allows them for that dog, and after the safety quiz.
home.safety4: During the walk, the owner can see live where the dog is. The route is deleted after 30 days.
home.safety5: After every walk, both sides give private feedback. Concerns go to our team, not to the other person.
home.safety6: You can always report or block someone. Anyone who breaks the rules is removed from the platform.
home.countriesText: Rondje works in the Netherlands, Belgium and Spain, in Dutch, French, Spanish and English.
home.freeTitle: Free, and it'll stay that way
home.freeText: No ads, no subscription, and we never sell data. Partners such as municipalities and foundations make Rondje possible.

quiz.title: Safety quiz
quiz.lede: Eight questions about walking safely. All correct? Then you can request solo walks.
quiz.passed: Passed! You can now request solo walks with owners who allow them.
quiz.failed: Almost. Take another look at the questions in red.

heat.q: It's 28 degrees. What do you do?
heat.a0: Just walk as usual, dogs cope well with heat
heat.a1: A short walk in the shade, bring water, and feel the pavement with your hand to check it isn't too hot
heat.a2: Have a good run, so it's over sooner

leash.q: Can the dog go off the leash?
leash.a0: Only if the owner has explicitly allowed it, and only where it's permitted
leash.a2: Yes, if the dog listens well

treats.q: You have a treat in your pocket. Can you give it?
treats.a2: Only if the profile says it's allowed

otherDogs.q: Another dog comes towards you. What do you do?
otherDogs.a0: Let them have a good sniff
otherDogs.a1: Keep your distance, ask the other owner first, and calmly walk on if you're unsure

escaped.q: The dog has got loose. What do you do first?
escaped.a0: Stay calm, don't chase or shout after the dog, and call the owner straight away
escaped.a1: Search yourself first, and only then call the owner

bite.q: The dog bites another dog. What do you do?
bite.a2: Make sure everyone is safe, exchange details, call the owner and report it in Rondje

stress.q: The dog yawns a lot, licks its lips and pulls away. What does that mean?
stress.a1: It's not feeling at ease; find a quieter spot

overdue.q: You're heading back later than agreed. What do you do?
overdue.a0: Let the owner know straight away
overdue.a1: Nothing, the app shows it anyway

quiz.alreadyPassed: You've already passed the quiz. You can always take it again.

safety.title: How Rondje handles safety
safety.lede: People don't hand their dog to just anyone. That's why we build trust step by step, and keep the platform clean.
safety.level1: New account: you can request a first meeting or join a supervised group walk.
safety.level2: After the first meeting: the owner has seen your ID in person and can allow solo walks for that one dog.
safety.level3: After the safety quiz: you can request solo walks with owners who allow them.
safety.duringText: Your phone shares your location with the owner while the walk is on. If it runs over, you both get a notification. The help button shows you straight away who to call.
safety.afterText: Both sides give private feedback. Reports of an injured or stressed dog, or of someone feeling unsafe, go straight to our team.
safety.fraudText: Rondje is free, so anyone asking for money stands out. Messages with payment requests, bank account numbers or links are flagged. Shelters are checked using their KvK, KBO or CIF number. Anyone who mistreats a dog or a person is blocked and reported where necessary.
safety.liabilityText: Rondje puts people in touch and is not itself a party to the arrangement. The owner remains liable for any damage the dog causes and must be insured for it. We recommend that walkers take out their own liability insurance. Read the terms for all the details.
safety.reportText: Report it using the ‘Report’ button on a profile, dog or walk. We'll look into it within 24 hours.

suggest.ownerTitle: Know someone with a dog who could use help?
suggest.ownerText: Rondje never contacts people who haven't signed up, and we store nothing about them here. This is how you can help:
suggest.ownerStep1: Ask them yourself first, for example over coffee. Tell them it is free and that you always meet together first.
suggest.ownerStep2: Help them sign up: you can also add a dog for someone else, if they agree.
suggest.ownerAddDog: Add a dog for someone else
suggest.ownerStep3: Or send your own invite link with this message:
suggest.ownerMessage: I know a free app where young people from the neighbourhood walk your dog. You always meet together first. Have a look: {url}
suggest.ownerSignup: Create an account to get your link
suggest.ownerPrivacy: Your link only shows that someone came through you. We never ask anyone for other people's details.
